RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, the August 8, 2002/Sravana 17, 1924 (Saka)

(Ministries :  Prime Minister; Agro and Rural Industries; Atomic Energy;
Communications and Information Technology; Consumer Affairs,
Food and Public Distribution; External Affairs; Labour;

Pensions; Planning; Road Transport and Highways;
Small Scale Industries; Space; Statistics and

Total number of questions—155
Basic infrastructure for tiny sector in
Tamil Nadu
2336. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the tiny sector industrial
units under the integrated infrastructural
development scheme for creation of basic
infrastructure in cluster basis in Tamil Nadu;
(b) whether the scheme is being extended
to other parts of the State where it is not in
operation now;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Comparative study of Khadi and
Village Industries
2337. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the Minister of AGRO
AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have carried
out a detailed comparative study of the Khadi
and Village Industries;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
(c) the details of the persons engaged in
Khadi and Village Industries in each State;
and
(d) what are their earnings per day,
State-wise?
Assistance to Plasma Institute,
Gandhinagar
†2338. SHRIMATI SAVITA
SHARDA: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are considering to provide more economic
assistance to Gandhinagar based Plasma
Institute;
(b) if so, whether Government have
taken any decision in this regard so far;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not, by
when a decision is likely to be taken?

Ill effects of nuclear tests
†2339. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the type of ill effects likely to be
caused as a result of nuclear tests conducted
in the country; and
(b) whether such tests can be carried out
at some other places also besides Rajasthan,
if so, the details thereof?
Prevention of nuclear radiation
2340. SHRI P. PRABHAKAR
REDDY: Will the PRIME MINISTER be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn to the news-item, "Pill to prevent
N-radiation" appearing in the ‘Times of
India’, dated the 15th June, 2002;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
(c) whether any study has been/is being
conducted in the matter so as to find out any
pharmaceutical agent to prevent/counteract
the effect of radiation; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Purchase of electricity from Nuclear
Power Corporation
2341. SHRI RAMACHANDRA
KHUNTIA: Will the PRIME MINISTER
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that most of the
State Electricity Boards are reluctant to
purchase electricity from the Nuclear Power
Corporation (NPC) as it is expensive in
comparison to Thermal/Hydel Power;
(b) if so, the outstanding amount to be
recovered by NPC from the State Electricity
Boards; and
(c) the steps taken to bring nuclear power
rates at par with Thermal/Hydel Power?
Phone connectivity in Faizabad
2342. SHRI RAJNATH SINGH
'SURYA': Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFOR-
MATION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of villages without
telephone connectivity in Faizabad district
of Uttar Pradesh;
(b) the reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps being taken to cover those
villages with telephone connections in
future?
New telecom circles in UP
2343. PROF. M. M.  AGARWAL: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to set up some new telecom circles
in Uttar Pradesh during the current financial
year;
(b) if so, the details of the schemes and
programmes formulated and implemented,
so far, in the State; and
(c) the necessary steps taken by
Government in this regard?
VSNL's outstanding dues against
telecom carriers
2344. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM: Will
the Minister of COMMUNICATIONS
AND INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a number of telecom carriers
